addAnotherDescription: Add another account, or a new channel, for this brand.
channelAvailability: {connectedCount, plural, one {# connected account} other {# connected accounts}} · {channelCount} channels available
connectAccountModalDescription: Choose a platform to connect. Search or browse by category.
connectAccountsDescription: Connect accounts to display them here.
telegramAddBot: Add the Genfeed bot to your Telegram group. This page updates when the group is connected.
connectSocialAccountsDescription: Connect your social media accounts to display them here.

facebookLive.description: Start a live video on {page}. Genfeed gives you the address and key to paste into your encoder.
facebookLive.encoderHelp: Paste both into your streaming software, then start streaming. The video goes live on the Page when the encoder connects.
facebookLive.endError: Could not end the live video. Try again in a moment.
facebookLive.endedDescription: The live video has ended. Facebook keeps the recording on the Page.
facebookLive.startError: Could not start the live video. If it keeps failing, reconnect the Page and grant video publishing.
facebookLive.streamKeyHelp: Shown once. Closing this window clears it from Genfeed.
facebookLive.title: Go live on Facebook

disconnectAccountDescription: {account} stops publishing for this brand. Other accounts on {platform} are untouched, and you can reconnect it later.
dmReconnectHint: This X account has no access to DMs. Click to reconnect it and turn them on.

beehiiv.apiKeyHelp: Create an API key in your Beehiiv workspace settings and paste it here.
beehiiv.description: Paste a Beehiiv API key. Articles from this brand publish to this publication.
beehiiv.publicationIdHelp: Starts with pub_. Leave empty to use your first publication.
beehiiv.title: Connect Beehiiv

apiKeyConnect.connectError: Could not connect. Try again in a moment.

devto.apiKeyHelp: Generate a key on dev.to under Settings → Extensions, then paste it here.
devto.description: Paste a dev.to API key. Articles from this brand publish to this author.
devto.title: Connect dev.to

errors.apiNotFound: That address answered, but not as a Ghost site. Enter the address you open Ghost Admin at, without /ghost.
errors.httpsRequired: Use the https:// address of your site.
errors.invalidKeyFormat: That is not an Admin API key. Ghost shows it as id:secret under Settings → Integrations.
errors.invalidUrl: That site URL is not valid. Enter its public address, for example https://yourblog.com.
errors.keyRejected: The key was rejected. Check that you copied all of it and that it has not been revoked.
errors.publicationNotFound: This key sees no matching publication. Check the publication ID, or leave it empty to use your first one.
errors.siteRedirected: That address redirects somewhere else. Enter the address your site finally opens at, including www if it uses it.
errors.siteUnreachable: Could not reach that site. Check the address for typos and that the site is online.

ghost.apiKeyHelp: Ghost Admin → Settings → Integrations → Add custom integration. Paste the Admin API key (id:secret).
ghost.description: Paste your Ghost site URL and Admin API key. Articles from this brand publish to this site.
ghost.title: Connect Ghost

health.accountAgeFailed: Platform account-age check failed. Missing or stale evidence is tracked separately.
health.accountAgeMissing: {publishedPosts, plural, one {# published post} other {# published posts}}. Native social-account age is not yet verified by the platform.
health.accountAgeStale: Platform account-age evidence is stale. Reconnect to refresh readiness checks.
health.accountAgeVerified: {publishedPosts, plural, one {# published post} other {# published posts}} across {connectedDays, plural, one {# connected day} other {# connected days}}.

reconnectReason.noIdentity: Sign-in didn't finish. Click to reconnect.

importOnConnectDescription: Import up to 90 days of posts from {account}. You can also import them later from the account's settings.
socialMediaDescription: Connect channels for this brand and review the profiles that are already linked.
